summary: A mixed day led by retail expansion momentum and a major legal ruling on teacher conduct under POCSO. Flipkart Minutes has quadrupled to 150+ cities in two years, while Delhi High Court rejected a long-standing bank reward denial.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court ruled Punjab & Sind Bank wrongfully denied 1998 robbery-foil reward to manager after 26-year legal battle.
Supreme Court held teacher hitting girl students on back/waist without sexual intent does not violate POCSO Act.
Flipkart Minutes grew 4x and expanded to 150+ cities in two years; Gen Z user base increased nearly fivefold annually.
Amorepacific targets 50% annual growth for three years to rank India among top-5 markets by FY30 via K-beauty portfolio.
Reliance Industries to issue 5-year bonds next week, per bankers; follows NSE listing signals and broader capital-raise momentum.
